content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Multi-affiliate asset manager earning asset-based fees through funds and separate accounts, the same core model as the target."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Boutique investment manager earning fees on funds and separate accounts sold to institutions and individuals."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Insurance brokerage earning carrier commissions on policies, not managing investment assets."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"US investment manager earning advisory fees on mutual funds, ETFs and separate accounts, matching the target's model."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Regulatory filing software and printing services for public companies, not investment management."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Alternative asset manager earning management fees on funds and separate accounts for institutional investors, including real assets."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Mainly research, data, ratings and software subscriptions; its portfolio management is a small side business."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Private markets manager earning management fees on funds, though its lending and venture focus differs from the target's public real asset strategies."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Primarily investment processing software and outsourced operations for financial institutions, not an investment manager."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Fee-based investment manager running separate accounts and pooled funds for wealthy clients and institutions."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Core business is financial software and outsourced back-office operations, not managing investment portfolios."},{"label":"C12","good":true,"reason":"Affiliated boutique investment managers earning fees on funds and separate accounts sold via advisers and institutions."},{"label":"C13","good":true,"reason":"ETF and fund sponsor earning management fees on fund assets, sold to advisers, institutions and individuals."}]}
